requirements.note: Blue right / gray left bubbles, oldest first from Jul 1, date headings at each day change ('Jul 3, 2026 at 4:20 PM' style, a date plus time rather than iMessage's day label). Opens at the newest message.
Send appends the message, stays at the bottom and clears the composer. Send is disabled when the field is empty or only spaces; Return adds a new line and the composer grows.
The composer rides on the keyboard and the newest messages stay visible. Dragging the thread dismisses the keyboard.
An italic 'Sam is typing…' text bubble, then a canned reply (e.g. 'Sure thing', 'Love that', 👍) about 2 s later. Two quick sends get two replies.
Long-press opens a system context menu with Copy and Delete, and both work (delete persists). But the lifted preview is a blank white pill with no bubble or text in it.
Flings to the first message without blank rows or jumps. A round 'Jump to newest message' button appears when you are far up and returns to the bottom.
Sent messages and Sam's replies survive a relaunch.

bugs: The long-press context-menu preview of a message is an empty white rounded rectangle: the bubble's colour and text are missing (seen every time).
tells: The context-menu preview renders blank instead of showing the lifted bubble.
The typing indicator is a static italic text bubble 'Sam is typing…' rather than the animated three-dot bubble.
Date headings read 'Oct 21, 2026 at 5:56 AM' (full year plus time) instead of iMessage-style 'Wednesday' / 'Sun, Oct 18'.
The plain nav bar shows 'Sam' alone, with no avatar.
A.scroll: Smooth and native-feeling: slow drags track the finger, flings decelerate normally, there were no blank or popping rows, and it reaches the first message cleanly. The jump-to-newest button works.

requirements.note: Blue right / gray left bubbles, oldest first, with iMessage-style day headings ('Wed, Jul 1', 'Thursday', 'Today'). Opens at the newest message.
Send appends the message, stays at the bottom and clears the composer. The send button is disabled when the field is empty or only spaces.
The composer sits on the keyboard and the newest messages stay visible. Dragging the thread dismisses the keyboard.
An animated three-dot bubble with 'Sam is typing…', then a canned reply about 2 s later. Two quick sends get two replies.
Long-press lifts the real bubble into a system context menu with Copy and Delete. Delete works and persists.
Flings to the first message without blank rows or jumps. A glass 'Scroll to newest message' button appears when you are far up and returns to the bottom.
Sent messages and replies survive a relaunch.

tells: The typing label next to the dots is very small, caption-sized text.
At the largest text size the separate glass send circle stays small next to the enlarged field, and bubbles show through it.
B.scroll: Smooth and native: it tracks the finger, decelerates naturally, shows no blank or popping rows and reaches the first message. Content slides under the glass nav bar and composer as on iOS 27.

why: Both apps meet nearly every requirement and scroll equally well. A's long-press preview is a blank white pill, while B lifts the real bubble. B also has the more iMessage-like details: an animated typing indicator, 'Wednesday'-style date headings and an avatar in the title.
